statements.impact_statement: idna is not an apothem runtime dependency. apothem's declared runtime set is click, rich, pyyaml, jsonschema (pyproject.toml [project.dependencies]); idna enters only transitively through development/network tooling and is absent from the installed apothem execution path.
joblib is not a declared apothem dependency in any extra (runtime, dev, security, release). It is an ambient package in the audit environment only and is not shipped in the apothem wheel.

markdown is not a declared apothem dependency after the documentation site moved to Next.js + Fumadocs. Any markdown finding comes from ambient audit tooling and is not present in the installed apothem runtime execution path.
nltk is not a declared apothem dependency in any extra. It is an ambient package in the audit environment only and is not shipped in the apothem wheel.
pymdown-extensions is not a declared apothem dependency after the documentation site moved to Next.js + Fumadocs. It is not present in the installed apothem runtime execution path.

urllib3 is not an apothem runtime dependency; apothem's audit utilities use the standard-library urllib.request, not urllib3. urllib3 enters only transitively through development/release tooling. Remediation tracked: upgrade to >= 2.7.0 via the dependency-update bot.
